wire.headline: Ironvale Brewing Cuts 2,400 Jobs as Deeside Plant Closes
sentences: Ironvale Brewing Co has announced plans to cut 2,400 jobs at its Deeside plant.
The closure of the Deeside facility is set to take effect on 4 November 2026.
CEO Marian Holt attributed the decision to an 18% drop in domestic beer sales.
Ironvale shares fell 12% during early trading hours following the announcement.
The company stated that its restructuring plan aims to save 310m GBP annually.
Production operations will shift to a new automated plant in Manchester.
Affected employees will receive 12 weeks' notice before the redundancy takes effect.
The total workforce across all UK sites will be reduced to 8,500.

PD.headline: Deeside Community Faces Economic Ripple Effects

sentences.text: Plans to cut 2,400 jobs at its Deeside plant have been announced by Ironvale Brewing Co.
Deeside local council estimates that 400 secondary jobs are currently at risk.

An 18% drop in domestic beer sales was attributed to the decision by CEO Marian Holt.
